fields.DESCRIPTION: The Ivory Breeze Woven Tote is the perfect companion for those who love minimalist charm with a natural touch. Handcrafted with fine woven straw in a soft ivory shade, it exudes a breezy, summery vibe. The sturdy tan faux leather handles add durability and elegance, making it ideal for everyday use, shopping sprees, beach holidays, or brunch outings. Spacious, lightweight, and eco-friendly – this tote is a blend of style and sustainability.
